mapper.select: SELECT * FROM equipment WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.id, e.category_id, c.name AS categoryName, e.lab_id, l.name AS labName, e.name, e.model, e.code, e.status, e.stock, e.min_minutes, e.max_days, e.allow_cross_day, e.need_qualification, e.purchase_date, e.description, e.image, e.version, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r2 WHERE r2.equipment_id = e.id AND r2.status = 'APPROVED' AND (r2.date < CURDATE() OR (r2.date = CURDATE() AND r2.start_time <= CURTIME())) AND (IFNULL(r2.end_date, r2.date) > CURDATE() OR (IFNULL(r2.end_date, r2.date) = CURDATE() AND r2.end_time > CURTIME()))) AS occupiedNow FROM equipment e LEFT JOIN equipment_category c ON e.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN lab l ON e.lab_id = l.id
AND (e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND e.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND e.lab_id = #{labId}
AND e.status = 'REPAIR'
AND e.status <> 'REPAIR'
ORDER BY e.id DESC

SELECT e.name AS name, SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, CONCAT(r.date, ' ', r.start_time), CONCAT(IFNULL(r.end_date, r.date), ' ', r.end_time))) AS totalMinutes FROM reservation r JOIN equipment e ON r.equipment_id = e.id WHERE r.status IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY r.equipment_id, e.name ORDER BY totalMinutes DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.stock), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = 'REPAIR' THEN e.stock ELSE 0 END), 0) AS repair, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation r WHERE r.status = 'APPROVED' AND (r.date < CURDATE() OR (r.date = CURDATE() AND r.start_time <= CURTIME())) AND (IFNULL(r.end_date, r.date) > CURDATE() OR (IFNULL(r.end_date, r.date) = CURDATE() AND r.end_time > CURTIME()))) AS occupied FROM equipment e
